tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every page starts here.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: table header rows, sidebars, diagram plates. Never a card with a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, rules and diagram strokes, on paper, panel and signal-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, footnotes, secondary readouts, on paper and panel.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Structural rules: under headers, table heads, section breaks. Alias of ink.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative only: background grid, row separators, inactive rings. Never the only cue for anything.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent (replaces the archetype's red): highlighted data, active nodes, the index square, primary marks. As text, on paper, panel and signal-tint.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill behind signal or ink text: highlighted table row, selected region of a diagram.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a signal fill (solid Tag, filled node labels).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The header band and solid black blocks. Flips to light in Void and Blueprint.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on the inverse band (page title, file code).

tokens.name: contrast-error
tokens.usage: Errors and negative results only: failed checks, out-of-tolerance values, destructive actions. As text and marks on paper and panel (4.9:1 or more in every theme; not on signal-tint). Text on a contrast-error fill is on-signal. Always paired with a word ("Error", "Failed", "Out of range"), never colour alone. Not for downward trends.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Condensed (Google Fonts). Set display and title uppercase.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title inside the inverse band. One per page, uppercase.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The big number in a Readout, Contents numbers, the value on a ProportionDial. Numerals only.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Hero figure: Readout size hero. One per page or slide. Numerals and a short suffix only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Readings stabilised after the third cycle and held within tolerance.
styles.usage: Running text in columns no wider than 64ch.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Fig. 2 — Distribution by sector, sampled weekly.
styles.usage: Footnotes and figure captions, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, file codes, tags, diagram callouts, table heads. Always uppercase.

styles.name: datum
styles.usage: Numbers and codes in table cells, right-aligned, tabular.

spacing.note: 4px base; layouts snap to an 8px grid.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding (horizontal), table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a rule and the text it introduces.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header band padding, table cell padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gutter, gap between readouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margin; height of the slim header band.

radius.note: Square everything. Only diagram nodes are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bands, blocks, tags, tables, inputs: everything rectangular.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes and dots only.

shadow.note: No elevation. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-colour gap, then 2px of solid signal. Square, follows the box.

stroke.note: Three line weights carry the whole hierarchy.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rings, leader lines, row separators, tag outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Rule under a header row or section title.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The index bar beside a section start; once per section.
